title: DEGR: Dual Exploration-Driven Generative Re-Ranking for Adaptive Cross-Request Context Bridging
title_zh: DEGR：用于自适应跨请求上下文桥接的双重探索驱动生成式重排序
abstract_en: In industrial recommendation systems, the re-ranking stage balances business objectives and diversity for sequence-level optimization while modeling contextual information. However, constrained by fixed upstream supply, existing methods fail to deliver further effectiveness gains, especially under low-quality supply. To overcome this, re-ranking can actively balance immediate and exploratory value, for instance, by prioritizing exploratory exposure under low-quality supply to preserve browsing potential and facilitate serendipitous conversions. Therefore, we propose a Dual Exploration-Driven Generative Re-Ranking (DEGR) method. DEGR adopts a hybrid supervised-reinforcement exploration and optimization paradigm, guided by an exploratory reward model that adaptively balances immediate and exploratory value. The hybrid optimization paradigm integrates three key components: supervised learning, exploration diversity constraint, and adaptive reward-weighted ORPO for preference optimization. Through this dual exploration, the generator ultimately acts as an adaptive cross-request contextual bridge. Offline and online experiments indicate that DEGR outperforms SOTA methods, achieving improvements of up to 1.22% UCTR and 0.20% PV in the JD E-commerce recommendation system.
abstract_zh: 工业推荐系统中的重排序阶段需要在序列级优化中平衡业务目标与多样性，并建模上下文信息。然而，现有方法受限于上游固定供给，尤其在低质量供给场景下难以继续提升效果。为此，论文提出 Dual Exploration-Driven Generative Re-Ranking（DEGR），通过主动平衡即时价值与探索价值，在低质量供给时优先提供探索性曝光，以保留用户浏览潜力并促进意外转化。DEGR 采用混合监督学习与强化探索优化范式，由探索性奖励模型自适应调节即时收益和探索收益；整体包含监督学习、探索多样性约束，以及基于自适应奖励加权的 ORPO 偏好优化。通过这种双重探索机制，生成器可作为自适应跨请求上下文桥梁。离线与线上实验表明，DEGR 优于现有 SOTA 方法，并在 JD 电商推荐系统中最高带来 1.22% UCTR 和 0.20% PV 提升。
key_points_zh: 针对工业推荐重排序受限于固定上游供给的问题，DEGR 强调在低质量供给下主动引入探索性曝光，而非仅优化即时点击或转化。
方法采用混合监督-强化探索优化范式，通过探索性奖励模型自适应平衡 immediate value 与 exploratory value。
核心训练组件包括 supervised learning、exploration diversity constraint，以及 adaptive reward-weighted ORPO，用于增强偏好优化与多样性控制。
DEGR 将生成式重排序器建模为跨请求上下文桥梁（cross-request contextual bridge），利用前后请求之间的探索反馈改善后续推荐。
在 JD E-commerce 推荐系统的离线与线上实验中，DEGR 超越 SOTA，最高提升 1.22% UCTR 和 0.20% PV。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant industrial e-commerce re-ranking paper with clear online gains, though it is more incremental than paradigm-changing.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度相关的工业电商重排序论文，具备明确线上收益，但整体更偏增量改进而非范式转变。
